dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: The first order of drinks has been packed. It's for the aunt of the wife of Miss Margaret's cousin. This is the address...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? A fresh face — someone Paimon's never met before! Paimon wants to go with you and say hello!

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: As you wish, Lady Paimon! I'll carry the drinks, and you can lead the way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take it easy with all those drinks!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't you worry about us! Paimon knows Mondstadt like the back of her hand... You just focus on mixing more drinks!
